scripts.build: bun run --filter scripts build && bun run --filter countries build
scripts.check-types: bun check --no-script -p packages/countries && bun check --no-script -p packages/scripts && bun check --no-script -p packages/test-js
scripts.ci: bun run lint && bun run check-types && bun run test
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run --filter test-js test
